text: The offline app collects nothing at all Komiks·Lab (com.bilohash.komikslab) contains every story, test and recording inside the installed app. It has no accounts and no network code — the modules that would talk to a server are not merely switched off, they are not included in the build. It works in airplane mode. Nothing leaves your device, so the rest of this policy applies only to the website and to the online app.
Who we are
Komiks·Lab is a Norwegian-learning project: a website at bilohash.com/comiks and two Android apps. It is run by Ruslan Bilohash, an individual developer.
Contact for any privacy question, including data deletion: email@bilohash.com. We answer within 30 days.
What the website and the online app collect
This covers bilohash.com/comiks and Komiks·Lab Online (com.bilohash.komikslab.online).
Only if you create an account
Data
Why
Email address
to sign in, confirm the account and reset a password
Display name and avatar
shown to your friends and in the ranking
Learning progress: tests taken, scores, streaks, mistakes
to continue where you stopped and build your practice plan
Friends, messages, wall posts
only if you use these features

Your password is never stored. We keep only a one-way hash of it (Argon2id), which cannot
    be turned back into the password.
Without an account
Your settings and progress stay in your own browser (localStorage) and never reach us.
A session cookie kl_s is set only after you sign in. There are no advertising or analytics cookies, and no third-party trackers.

The server keeps a short-lived, hashed form of your IP address to limit abuse
      (rate limiting). It is not linked to a person and is not used for anything else.
Who else sees the data

We never sell data and never share it for advertising. Data reaches other companies only
    where a feature technically requires it:
Service
What is sent
When
Hostinger (EU hosting)
everything stored: account, progress, messages
always — this is where the site runs
OpenAI
your microphone audio and the text of the conversation
only during a spoken practice call, and only while it lasts
OpenAI / Anthropic / Groq / xAI
the sentence you wrote, without your name or email
only when you ask for your writing to be checked
Google Fonts
your IP address, as with any web font
when a page loads its fonts
Stripe
payment details, handled entirely by Stripe
not in use — learning is free and there is nothing to pay for
These features exist only on the website and in the online app. The offline app has none of them.
How long we keep it
Account and progress — until you delete the account.
Messages and wall posts — until you or a moderator delete them.
Sign-in sessions — 30 days, then they expire.
Rate-limiting records — hours, then they are overwritten.
Spoken practice — the audio is not recorded or stored on our side.
Your rights
Under the GDPR you may ask for a copy of your data, ask to correct it, or ask us to delete it.
Delete your account yourself: open your profile in the app or on the site → Account → Delete account. This removes the account, progress, friends and messages.
Or write to email@bilohash.com and we will do it for you.
You may also complain to your national data protection authority.
Children

The apps are rated for everyone, but accounts, friends and messages are meant for users
    aged 13 and over. We do not knowingly create accounts for younger children. A parent who
    believes their child made an account can write to us and we will remove it.
Younger learners can use the offline app, which has no account and sends nothing anywhere.
Security

All traffic uses HTTPS. Passwords are hashed with Argon2id. The database and the
    configuration with credentials sit outside the public web folder and are closed to direct
    access. Only the site owner has administrative access.
Changes

If this policy changes in a way that matters, the date at the top changes and the update
    is announced on the “What's new” page of the site.
